title: Baked Galangal and Italian Sausage
description: A unique twist on traditional Italian sausage with the earthy flavor of galangal. This baked dish is easy to make and packed with flavor.

ingredients.name: Italian Sausage (Syrian)
ingredients.notes: make sure to get a mix that includes galangal

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the galangal into 1 inch pieces. Place on the baking sheet.
Cut the ginger into 1/2 inch pieces. Place on the baking sheet.
Cut the Italian sausage into 1 inch pieces. Place on the baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the sausage and galangal. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Bake in the oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Brush the sausage with more olive oil if needed.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven. The sausage should be cooked through and the galangal should be tender.
Serve hot with your choice of sides.
